QuestInfo.name: Cassandra's Christmas Present
QuestInfo.0: Cassandra has a special gift for you if you help her with something.
QuestInfo.1: Cassandra will give you a Christmas present for wiping out 300 monsters around your level. You'll get a bonus gift if you open the box at level 200 or above.
QuestInfo.2: You wiped out 300 monsters for Cassandra and received a gift. Is killing hundreds of monsters due to one of Cassandra's whims really the appropriate way to celebrate Christmas?
